description: Hand off a whole research or lookup task in one call: a Claude Haiku 5.5 agent plans the steps, calls up to 38 agentsvc.io tools in parallel (web and news search, page reading, papers, GitHub and npm, company registers and sanctions, crypto prices, token checks, DeFi TVL and yields, wallets, FX and macro data, weather, DNS, WHOIS, SSL, CVEs) and returns a Markdown answer with sources and the list of tool calls it made. Up to 12 steps and about 90 seconds. Read only: it cannot spend money or send anything. Example: compare two DeFi protocols, check a company and its domain, or summarize what changed this week on a topic. AI-written, check the sources. Price: $0.5 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"task":"What is the TVL of Aave and Morpho right now? Answer in two sentences.","max_steps":4}.
